sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and frustrated, feeling panicked that bad luck has already ruined her careful first-day start, with a strong urge to complain out loud.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She jolts from frantic urgency into puzzled concern, momentarily forgetting her own panic as she tries to make sense of the trembling figure ahead.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts from frantic self-stress into immediate concern and gentle protectiveness, trying to sound reassuring despite still being flustered.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts instantly from frantic impatience to protective concern, feeling urgent sympathy and a determined need to steady the crying boy and take charge.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: ...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels frustrated and resigned about being late, but her concern for the crying boy has overridden her own plans, leaving her with a flustered, self-sacrificing determination.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s pushing past her frustration and lateness to focus on the boy, sounding brisk and caring as she tries to take charge and reassure him.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels determined and reassuring, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can take charge and help Kota feel safe.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and brisk, trying to calm the boy while mentally narrowing down clues, with a faint undercurrent of worry and urgency beneath her upbeat, take-charge tone.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and reassuring, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can take charge and make the frightened boy feel safe.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and urgent, pushing aside her own lateness to sound clear and helpful while quietly worrying about the boy and hoping someone answers quickly.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and quietly proud, softening into warm reassurance as she downplays the scare and praises the boy’s courage.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s relieved and lightly teasing, using humor to mask how shaken and protective she still feels after helping the lost boy.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a mix of comic despair and lingering panic about being late, but underneath it she’s relieved and satisfied that the boy was safely reunited with his mother.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels tired and resigned about being late, but warmly satisfied and quietly proud that helping Kota made the delay feel completely worthwhile.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

gpt.rationale: Aoi’s expressive panic, irritation, initiative, and bright recovery fit an outgoing lead-taking personality, though the long run of repeated 'determined' sprites flattens several distinct emotional beats.

claude.rationale: Opening anxious/angry/confused and closing smile/embarrassed fit her expressive personality, but the long stretch of repeated 'determined' flattens distinct emotional beats like reassurance, resignation, and tender questioning.
